owner.note: Who runs the shop (Figma page Trade / About). PLACEHOLDERS until Gio fills them: name, bio, Instagram and Mixes links. Discogs (highmuzik) and Instagram (giouann) are real (Gio, 2026-11-12/13); Facebook is real too (Gio, 2026-11-13), used only for the verification button, not listed on About (the profile URL carries his full name); stats show only the join year until the ratings are checked. No legal name or address here (that is the Impressum).
owner.name: Gio
owner.bio: Placeholder: who you are in three lines. DJ and collector, what you play, where. These records come from my own crates.

newsletter.note: Footer newsletter signup (decision 0076). action = the Buttondown subscribe URL (https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/rythem-works). Empty = the footer shows no signup. Switched on 2026-11-14: the Privacy page names Buttondown (decision 0079).

legal.note: Legal pages (decisions 0079, 0093): content/legal/*.md, {{legal.x}} is filled from here; empty = a bracketed placeholder on the page, listed by the build. Gio sells privately (2026-11-15): no address, no phone, no VAT line, no Impressum: name + email, and the contact form (site.json → contact). email = the shop contact address, also shown on /contact/ (provisional: see _context/provisional-names.md). updated = date of the last change to Privacy.

contact.note: Contact form on /contact/ (decision 0093). endpoint = URL of the Supabase function contact (supabase/functions/contact, deploy with Verify JWT OFF, secret CONTACT_TO or OFFER_TO); empty = the form says it is not switched on yet and points to the email.

trade.note: Trade offers (Figma page Trade). offerEndpoint = URL of the Supabase function trade-offer; empty = the form shows that offers are not switched on yet. searchEndpoint = URL of the Supabase function discogs-search (decision 0069); empty = "Which record" is a plain text field.

pages.note: noindex = every page answers X-Robots-Tag: noindex (_headers), while the shop is on staging and rythem-works.com shows the coming-soon page (build-coming-soon.js). Set to false at launch. Cloudflare Pages (npm run build:pages): served from the web root. The top-level values are the GoDaddy staging (gio-d.xyz/zanza).

comingSoon.note: Temporary page of rythem-works.com while the shop is on staging (build-coming-soon.js, Figma page Coming soon, decision 0096). text = Figma `coming soon` text property. email = the Contact link (mailto).
comingSoon.title: Opening soon
comingSoon.text: Reggae and dancehall records from my crates. The shop opens soon: leave your email and you’ll hear first.

checkout.note: Stripe Checkout (migration 0021, _context/backend.md → Checkout con hold). endpoint = URL of the Supabase function create-checkout; empty = Checkout in the Bag says checkout is not open yet.
